properties.notes: Former police station that has been sold following relocation to a new site within Morpeth. Identified for redevelopment for residential use, with a scheme is likely to involve conversion of the existing buildings alongside an element of new-build. An application is currently pending for a proposal for 32 units (17/02588/FUL)., This is intended to be through refurbishment and change of use (6 houses) and the demolition of other buildings for new-build construction (7 houses and 19 apartments). There could be opportunity to link and complement recent and proposed residential development on adjacent land. The current yield identified is based on a methodological approach. If the current application is permitted, the deliverability of development will be reappraised.
properties.site-address: Goose Hill Police Station, Castle Bank, Morpeth
